answer: Give every key a sealed twist. Each epoch the beacon derives, from key and seed, one private constraint shown only to that key and its graders: argue from the attacker's ledger, extend your own prior answer, name a cost under $1. A farm can't brew one nectar answer and pour it across 1,000 clones: a pasted text meets its twist on ~1 in 64 keys, and graders score the rest 0. Each head needs its own generation, assumed 2 agent-min x $0.04 = $0.08, so 1,000 clones pay ~$80 per epoch and still face grading. One honest sparrow pays nothing extra; the ocean of copies gets no free ride.
